The KnightLoader browser extension, as it goes to the browser stores. This release folds every earlier development release of the extension (1.0.0 to 1.23.0) and the store preparation into one version.

## ✨ What it does

- **Send to your own instances.** Right-click a link, an image, selected text or the page itself, or use the toolbar popup to send the page you are on. With several instances the popup asks where it should go, and one of them can be the default.
- **Click'n'Load, in the browser.** Download sites hand their link lists to a download manager on the same computer. The extension catches those buttons inside the page, whichever way a site submits them, and sends the links to your instance wherever it runs. The popup counts down before it sends, and the countdown can be cancelled or set to ask every time.
- **One connection phrase is the whole setup.** The twelve words your KnightLoader instances share are all the extension needs: no address, no password, no account. Messages travel through a relay, end-to-end encrypted, so the relay cannot read the links you send.
- **Your instances at a glance.** Instance cards in the popup and the options page show whether each one is online and what its queue is doing, and let you pause or resume a queue or open its web interface. In the popup they update while you watch.
- **A link collector.** Paste or drop several links, or a file that contains them, into the popup and send them together.
- **The KnightLoader look.** Light and dark theme, corners, accent colour and rainbow mode, or with one switch the corners, colours and rainbow of your default instance. 42 languages, right-to-left ones laid out as such.

## 🔒 Privacy

- No analytics, no advertising, no tracking. The privacy policy (`extension/PRIVACY.md`) lists what is stored, what is sent and to whom, what the Click'n'Load script does in pages, and how long the relay keeps anything.
- Switching Click'n'Load off removes the page script and its network rule for every page opened afterwards.
- Leaving the group deletes the phrase, the default instance and the browser's random member ID.

## 🧩 Browsers

- Chrome, Edge and other Chromium browsers.
- Firefox 140 and later on desktop, with the data it sends declared at install. It is not offered for Firefox for Android, which has no right-click menus.
